note: Deliverable Studio scaffolds (Mission Control spec section 3.6) plus the first-run artifact templates (section 13, step 5). No output may be presented as final or approved merely because it was generated.

project-charter.title: Project Charter
project-charter.description: One-page authorization for a project: why, what, who, and how success is measured.

sections.heading: Problem and background
sections.guidance: Describe the current state, who is affected, and the evidence that a problem exists.

sections.heading: Aim
sections.guidance: State the SMART aim: how much of what improvement, for whom, by when.

sections.heading: Scope and boundaries
sections.guidance: Name what is in scope, what is out, and the settings involved.

sections.heading: Team, sponsor, and stakeholders
sections.guidance: List the owner, sponsor, collaborators, and who must be consulted.

sections.heading: Measures
sections.guidance: Define structure, process, outcome, and balancing measures with baselines.

sections.heading: Approvals and governance
sections.guidance: Record required approvals, data authority, and review checkpoints.

aim-statement-driver-diagram.title: Aim Statement and Driver Diagram Inputs
aim-statement-driver-diagram.description: A precise aim plus the primary and secondary drivers that could move it.

sections.heading: Aim statement
sections.guidance: How much of what, for whom, by when. Avoid vague verbs.

sections.heading: Primary drivers
sections.guidance: The big system factors that directly influence the aim.

sections.heading: Secondary drivers
sections.guidance: The specific processes or conditions under each primary driver.

sections.heading: Change ideas
sections.guidance: Concrete, testable changes mapped to drivers.

evidence-summary.title: Literature or Evidence Summary
evidence-summary.description: A sourced synthesis that separates evidence from opinion.

sections.heading: Question
sections.guidance: The structured question this summary answers (PICO/PICOT where suitable).

sections.heading: Sources reviewed
sections.guidance: Each source with author, year, type, and evidence level. Label verified source, local policy, user-provided context, AI synthesis, or assumption.

sections.heading: Findings
sections.guidance: What the evidence shows, including conflicting results.

sections.heading: Limitations and currency
sections.guidance: Gaps, quality concerns, and publication or review dates.

sections.heading: Implications for local practice
sections.guidance: What this could mean here; local policy takes precedence over general findings.

policy-procedure-draft.title: Policy or Procedure Draft
policy-procedure-draft.description: A draft for institutional review — never effective until approved through governance.

sections.heading: Purpose and scope
sections.guidance: Why the policy exists and who it applies to.

sections.heading: Definitions
sections.guidance: Terms a new reader needs.

sections.heading: Policy statements or procedure steps
sections.guidance: Numbered, testable statements or steps with roles.

sections.heading: Evidence and references
sections.guidance: Sources with dates; note where evidence is thin.

sections.heading: Review and approval path
sections.guidance: Committees, owners, effective and review dates — to be completed by the institution.

education-plan.title: Education Plan / Lesson Plan
education-plan.description: A teaching plan with objectives, methods, and evaluation.

sections.heading: Needs assessment
sections.guidance: The gap this education addresses and how it was identified.

sections.heading: Audience and prerequisites
sections.guidance: Who this is for and what they already know.

sections.heading: Learning objectives
sections.guidance: Observable objectives using a suitable taxonomy.

sections.heading: Methods and materials
sections.guidance: Formats, activities, accessibility considerations, and time.

sections.heading: Evaluation
sections.guidance: How learning and transfer to practice will be measured.

competency-checklist.title: Competency Checklist
competency-checklist.description: Observable criteria for a skill or judgment domain. Verification requires a qualified human observer.

sections.heading: Competency and domain
sections.guidance: Name the competency and whether it covers knowledge, skill, judgment, or behavior.

sections.heading: Performance criteria
sections.guidance: Observable, yes/no criteria in the order performed.

sections.heading: Evidence requirements
sections.guidance: What must be demonstrated, how often, and in what setting.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.guidance: Observer qualifications and signoff — cannot be completed by AI.

case-study.title: Case Study (Synthetic)
case-study.description: A teaching case built only from synthetic or fully de-identified material.

sections.heading: Learning objectives
sections.guidance: What the reader should be able to do afterward.

sections.heading: Scenario
sections.guidance: Synthetic scenario only — no real identifiers, dates, or facility details.

sections.heading: Progression and decision points
sections.guidance: How the situation evolves and where judgment is required.

sections.heading: Discussion questions
sections.guidance: Questions that surface reasoning, not recall alone.

sections.heading: Debrief notes
sections.guidance: Key teaching points and common misconceptions.

meeting-pack.title: Meeting Brief, Agenda, Minutes, and Action List
meeting-pack.description: One pack covering preparation, the meeting itself, and follow-through.

sections.heading: Meeting brief
sections.guidance: Purpose, desired outcome, and background readers need.

sections.heading: Agenda
sections.guidance: Timed items with owners and intended outcomes (decide, discuss, inform).

sections.heading: Minutes
sections.guidance: Decisions made, dissent noted, and unresolved questions.

sections.heading: Action list
sections.guidance: Actions with owner, due date, and follow-up checkpoint.

executive-brief.title: Executive Brief
executive-brief.description: One page for a decision-maker: situation, options, recommendation, and ask.

sections.heading: Situation
sections.guidance: What is happening and why it matters now, in plain language.

sections.heading: Evidence and assumptions
sections.guidance: What is known, what is assumed, and confidence in each.

sections.heading: Options and tradeoffs
sections.guidance: Two to four options with cost, risk, and reversibility.

sections.heading: Recommendation and ask
sections.guidance: The recommended option and the specific decision requested.

presentation-poster-outline.title: Presentation or Poster Outline
presentation-poster-outline.description: A structured outline ready to build into slides or a poster.

sections.heading: Title and authors
sections.guidance: Working title and contributor roles.

sections.heading: Key message
sections.guidance: The single sentence the audience should remember.

sections.heading: Outline
sections.guidance: Section-by-section flow with one idea per slide or panel.

sections.heading: Visuals and data
sections.guidance: Figures or tables needed, with sources and permissions.

abstract-manuscript-scaffold.title: Abstract or Manuscript Scaffold
abstract-manuscript-scaffold.description: IMRaD scaffolding with disclosure and authorship prompts.

sections.heading: Background and question
sections.guidance: Why this work was needed and the exact question.

sections.heading: Methods
sections.guidance: Design, setting, participants or data, and analysis approach.

sections.heading: Results
sections.guidance: Findings with denominators and uncertainty — no results may be fabricated.

sections.heading: Discussion and limitations
sections.guidance: Interpretation, limitations, and generalizability.

sections.heading: Disclosures
sections.guidance: Funding, conflicts, ethics/IRB status, and AI-assistance disclosure.

communication-plan.title: Communication Plan
communication-plan.description: Who needs to hear what, from whom, through which channel, and when.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.guidance: What the communication must achieve.

sections.heading: Audiences
sections.guidance: Each audience, what they care about, and anticipated concerns.

sections.heading: Messages and channels
sections.guidance: Key messages per audience with channel and sender.

sections.heading: Timeline and feedback
sections.guidance: Sequence, cadence, and how feedback returns.

message-draft.title: Email, Memo, Announcement, or Huddle Script
message-draft.description: A short communication draft. Sending is always a human action.

sections.heading: Audience and purpose
sections.guidance: Who receives this and the single action or awareness it seeks.

sections.heading: Draft text
sections.guidance: The message itself, in the audience's language.

sections.heading: Sender checklist
sections.guidance: Accuracy, tone, timing, and approvals confirmed before the human sends.

dashboard-summary.title: Dashboard Summary
dashboard-summary.description: A narrative summary of measures with definitions and freshness.

sections.heading: Measures included
sections.guidance: Each measure with definition, source, denominator, and freshness.

sections.heading: What changed
sections.guidance: Movements that matter, with known operational context.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.guidance: Data quality caveats and what the numbers cannot say.

sections.heading: Suggested attention
sections.guidance: Where a human should look next — suggestions, not conclusions.

personal-development-plan.title: Personal Development / Learning Plan
personal-development-plan.description: A private plan for growth: goals, activities, evidence, and review dates.

sections.heading: Goals
sections.guidance: Up to three goals with why each matters now.

sections.heading: Learning activities
sections.guidance: Courses, practice, mentorship, and stretch work mapped to goals.

sections.heading: Evidence of progress
sections.guidance: What will show movement — artifacts, feedback, verified competencies.

sections.heading: Review cadence
sections.guidance: When you will review and adjust this plan.

structured-question.title: Structured Question
structured-question.description: Convert confusion or curiosity into a respectful, answerable question.

sections.heading: What I observed or was taught
sections.guidance: The trigger for the question, without identifiers.

sections.heading: What I understand so far
sections.guidance: Your current understanding and its source.

sections.heading: The question
sections.guidance: One precise question the right person can answer.

sections.heading: Who to ask and when
sections.guidance: Faculty, preceptor, educator, pharmacy, or manager — and the right moment.

project-one-pager.title: Project One-Pager
project-one-pager.description: The minimum viable project definition to test interest and sponsorship.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.guidance: The problem in two sentences, with who feels it.

sections.heading: Idea
sections.guidance: The change you want to try.

sections.heading: First measure
sections.guidance: One number that would show movement.

sections.heading: Support needed
sections.guidance: Sponsor, time, data, or permission required to start.

evidence-question.title: Evidence Question (PICO/PICOT)
evidence-question.description: A searchable clinical or operational evidence question.

sections.heading: Population
sections.guidance: Who the question is about.

sections.heading: Intervention or issue
sections.guidance: The exposure, change, or practice in question.

sections.heading: Comparison
sections.guidance: The alternative, including current practice.

sections.heading: Outcome and timeframe
sections.guidance: What result matters and over what period.

sections.heading: Search plan
sections.guidance: Where you will look and how you will label what you find.

research-question.title: Research Question (FINER)
research-question.description: A research question checked for feasibility, interest, novelty, ethics, and relevance.

sections.heading: Draft question
sections.guidance: The question in one sentence.

sections.heading: FINER check
sections.guidance: Feasible, Interesting, Novel, Ethical, Relevant — one honest line each.

sections.heading: Research versus QI
sections.guidance: Initial determination and why; IRB/ethics consultation is the authority.

sections.heading: Next governance step
sections.guidance: The first approval or consultation required before any data work.
